IIT Gandhinagar Summer Research Internship Programme (SRIP) 2027

At least eight weeks of on-campus research with IIT Gandhinagar faculty across engineering, sciences, humanities and design.

STIPEND / MONTH
₹8,000
Stipend details
₹2,000 per week (₹16,000 for 8 weeks) plus free hostel accommodation; top performers can win the ₹50,000 Bhalodia-Khetan Excellence Award.
Expected application window
To be confirmed
Format & location
In person · Gandhinagar, Gujarat
Who can apply
Students pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree at a prominent Indian institution, with a strong academic record and a statement of purpose matched to a listed project.
Accommodation & support
Free hostel accommodation · ₹50,000 Excellence Award for top performers

Entry notes

  • The 2026 edition ran 7 May–16 July 2026; applications usually open in January–February.
